title: A tank with a hole (ছিদ্রওয়ালা ট্যাংক)
placement: Book page 146, topic 5.4.1 (টরিসেলির পরীক্ষা): after চিত্র ৫.১০, as a second example of 'নলের উপরে কোনো ফুটো নেই, তাই সেদিক দিয়ে বাতাস চাপ দিতে পারছে না' (the owner's third picture).
description: A tank with a hole (the owner's third picture, beside page 146, topic 5.4.1) in a plain school lab (a teak bench, a blue-grey wall): one glass tank of water with a screw lid and a red cork in a hole near the bottom. One button steps through it: pull the cork with the lid on: a few drops come and stop, and an outlined blue arrow shows the outside air pressing on the hole, as in Torricelli's tube; take off the lid: the arrow moves to the water's surface, a jet spurts out and, as the tank drains (shown faster), the depth h above the hole (orange) falls and the jet weakens; then refill. The panel shows one short line, h and the rule. Test tab: 3 questions (lid on, lid off, the tank draining), every wrong choice with its own note. Split from torricelli-barometer. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
